The '''''StarViper''-class attack platform''' was a [[Heavy assault starfighter/Legends|heavy assault starfighter]] that was based on [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] ''[[Virago]]'', modeled after an old starship variant of [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid,]] and was used extensively in the criminal underworld during the era of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Please repeat the communication, over.|A Zann Consortium StarViper pilot|<ref name="FoC" />}}
[[File:Dalan_Oberos_StarViper_GFH.png|thumb|left|200px|Dalan Oberos' personal ''StarViper'']]
The ''StarViper'' was equipped with dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] of medium destructive power, and unlike other starfighters, it was short in length but tall, lacking a fuselage. It had decent armor and was fairly quick, but was expensive, which meant that it was not deployed in large [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]].

The ''StarViper'' was also able to release [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]] that would harm nearby craft.

==History==
The ''[[Virago]]'' was commissioned by Xizor as his personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. He collaborated directly with [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] on its design, and he purchased all production rights upon completion to ensure the ship would remain unique. Xizor's personal version of the ship featured a super-advanced targeting computer that greatly increased the performance of whatever weapons the ship happened to be using. 

A large number of ''StarViper''s (obviously less powerful than ''Virago'') were part of [[Xizor's navy|Xizor's private]] [[navy/Legends|navy]], defending ''[[Falleen's Fist]]'' above [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the [[Destruction of Xizor's Palace|destruction]] of [[Xizor's Palace|his palace]] by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], Xizor ordered the destruction of the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' on which they escaped, wanting the death of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. An overwhelming number of ships [[Battle over Coruscant|attacked and surrounded]] the ''Falcon'' and the ''[[Outrider/Legends|Outrider]]''.<ref name="SOTE6" /><ref name="SOTEvg" />

Following Xizor's death, MandalMotors reacquired the production rights and released a ''StarViper'' variant less powerful than ''Virago'' to the open market. In addition, [[Mandal Hypernautics Corporation|Mandal Hypernautics]] began producing the fighter.

[[File:Virago-SWG7.jpg|thumb|Prince Xizor's ''Virago'']]
''StarViper''s formed the main starfighter force of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]], and they were modified to carry and deploy swarms of old [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Pistoeka sabotage droids]] that the consortium obtained via the [[Black market/Legends|black market]], proving superior to [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptors]] such as the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]].<ref name="FoC" />

These fighters were also employed in small numbers by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces present on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FoC" /> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dalan Oberos]] owned a personal ''StarViper'' which was painted a reddish-brown color.<ref name="Guns for Hire">{{FFGXW|set=Guns for Hire Expansion Pack|cardname=Dalan Oberos}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Mission to Mandalore (Zann Consortium)|Mission to Mandalore]] from ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' depicts the Zann Consortium deploying squadrons of ''StarViper''s as early as [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Various appearances of the [[Battle over Coruscant]] in ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' depict dozens of these fighters belonging to the [[Black Sun]] navy and attacking the ''Millennium Falcon''.<ref name="SOTEcard">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Battle Over Coruscant: Part III|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC068.jpg|archiveurl=}}</ref><ref name="SOTE6">[[Shadows of the Empire 6|''Shadows of the Empire'' 6]]</ref><ref name="SOTEvg">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref>

The reference book ''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' refers to Xizor's ships appearing in the video game as "Shock Raiders."

[[File:Basiliskkotor.jpg|left|thumb|200px|Canderous Ordo's divergent Basilisk war droid, similar in appearance to the ''StarViper'']]
[[Canderous Ordo]]'s [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]], as seen in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', is strikingly similar in appearance to the ''StarViper''. It was retconned that the ship was based on one of the Mandalorian Basilisk war droid models, which, according to [[Chris Avellone]], was done deliberately to improve on the designs done for the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="Obsidian Forum">{{WebCite|url=http://forums.obsidianent.com/index.php?showtopic=28328&st=30|text=The List of Continuity Mistakes, don't hate me, just having some fun|date=2005-02-23|author=[[Chris Avellone|Avellone, Chris]]|work=[http://forums.obsidianent.com/index.php Invision Power Board]|archivedate=20070301232217|nolive=1}}</ref>
